constraints.description: Do not clear if fused fraud risk > 0.80

goals.description: Minimize fraud loss without reckless SLA breach

blue_r1.what: Clear the wire immediately to protect SLA; investigate post-posting

red_r1.description: Fraud spike: fused risk jumps to 0.88 via synthetic identity cluster
red_r1.rationale: Clearing now would violate must_not fused-risk>0.80; expected loss >> tolerance.

blue_r2.what: Patch: hard hold + step-up KYC; offer SLA exception credit within policy
blue_r2.rationale: Stops the clear-on-spike kill shot; spends small operational cost.

red_r2.description: Client escalates SLA pressure; partial document set still incomplete
red_r2.rationale: Pressures SLA but risk remains elevated — hold still correct.

blue_r3.what: Final: release only after risk <0.80 and dual-control approval
blue_r3.rationale: Survivor procedure balances SLA credit vs fraud gate.

baseline: ONE-SHOT BASELINE: Clear now. Medium score 0.62 is below panic threshold; SLA breach costs more than theoretical fraud. Investigate asynchronously. Confidence: high. (Overconfident — misses coordinated spike to 0.88.)

memo.title: Recommend hard hold with dual-control release
